name: Jiangsu Guotai International Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Guotai International Group Co., Ltd. manages a diverse business portfolio, primarily focused on international trade involving the import and export of consumer products such as textiles, clothing, and toys. Beyond its global commerce activities, the company also dedicates resources to the research, development, and manufacturing of specialized chemical products, notably lithium-ion battery electrolyte and silane coupling agents. Its operations further extend into real estate development and various financial investment ventures. The group, which was established in 1997, transitioned its name from Jiangsu Guotai International Group Guomao Co., Ltd. to its current title in May 2019, and its main office is situated in Zhangjiagang, China.
